components.name: Chip
components.description: Chip — compact pill the user toggles (Filter) or removes (Input). Filter: Default · Hover · Selected (fill/inverse) · Disabled · Focus, optional Count. Input: Default · Hover · Disabled · Focus with a remove (×). Size S 32 for dense rows, M 40 for touch; Direction LTR / RTL. Fill-separated, no border; Focus uses the shared _Focus ring. Use Tag/Badge for static labels; place chips in a horizontally

Filter chips narrow a list; Input chips show values the user added (tags, recipients) and can be removed.
